Made with Natural Earth.
Land vectors: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Natural Earth raster and vector data are public domain.
Derived geometry: 2-degree triangular surface sampling and original coastline segments.
This generalized geographic layer does not show current weather or navigable routes.

Atmospheric Atlas (2026-09-21): 50m land + admin_0_boundary_lines_land; 110m country labels.
Natural Earth commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19.
Public-domain vectors simplified at 0.025 degrees and rounded to 3 decimals.
Reproduce: node tools/generate-map-geography.mjs. Borders are generalized geographic references.
